title: Autopsy and Portrait
author: Edmund Blackwood
blurb: Ulyana Yarrow, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the trial begins.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
